subject.title: [Bug]: Browser interactions can exhaust model context by injecting too much page content

question: Should browser interactions default to compact, goal-shaped reads and post-action change reports, with raw or full snapshots kept as an explicit escape hatch?
rationale: Current main already has caps and selectable efficient snapshots, but the remaining request changes model-facing browser semantics and compatibility rather than repairing a narrow broken invariant.

options.title: Adopt compact browser default
options.body: Make compact task-relevant browser output and small action change reports the default while requiring raw or full page reads to be explicitly requested.

options.title: Keep capped snapshots default
options.body: Keep the current capped snapshot behavior and treat efficient mode plus docs as the supported mitigation for now.

options.title: Fold into broader browser roadmap
options.body: Track this under the broader browser automation improvement thread before choosing the browser-specific default contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt compact browser default
recommendation.body: Make compact task-relevant browser output and small action change reports the default while requiring raw or full page reads to be explicitly requested.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for browser snapshot defaults, efficient mode, and docs points to this person for the product/default decision.
